page.overview:
Who is Lone Wolf the Pickpocket?

Lone Wolf the Pickpocket is a recurring character in the Final Fantasy series. He is a werewolf, a thief, and steals treasure from chests before the party obtains them. He is frequently seen imprisoned.

Lone Wolf is a werewolf imprisoned in Castle Walse. The party can free him or leave him captured. If he is freed, he will steal some treasures from chests in dungeons elsewhere in the world, leaving a note behind, and the party cannot get the loot.

The last chance to free him is before warping to Galuf's world. While Castle Walse exists in the merged world, it cannot be reached by any normal-play means before re-obtaining the airship, at which point Exdeath promptly casts Walse, among other places, into the void, rendering it inaccessible.

Those five treasures are not counted on the percent of treasures looted, and the Blitz Whip can also be stolen from Flaremancers in the Fork Tower and Sealed Temple, but it will be lost forever if not obtained before the tower's destruction.
